email.subject: my turn??
email.body:
ok I can't need a wizard forever. I found my old laptop. send me commands and I'll type EXACTLY what you send, like: write dex ls. the newsletter photo is on there somewhere. my notes say which. teach me to bounce back.

Dex

how.txt: sends one command to dex's laptop.
he types it exactly. typos too.

Newsletter photo = photo 4. the one where we're all jumping.
coach says we bounced back. coach is right for once

replies.right: I opened it MYSELF. I'm bouncing back. tell the whole town: we can fix things by hand.
